## Legal gate

Check every box that applies to this change. If none apply, check the last box.
**If any of the first six are checked, request review from JRA Legal Review before merge.**

- [ ] Adds, removes, or changes a third-party script, pixel, embed, tag, or font
- [ ] Adds, removes, or changes anything a form collects
- [ ] Changes a price, guarantee, refund, or offer date
- [ ] Adds or changes a claim about what the product does
- [ ] Adds a page or route that collects data or makes a claim
- [ ] Changes where data goes, who can see it, or how long it is kept
- [ ] **None of the above. This change is styling, layout, performance, a bug fix, or copy that touches no claim.**

<!-- Why this exists: the privacy policy names Meta and Google Fonts specifically and
     nothing else, so that adding a third tracker forces an update rather than hiding
     under a catch-all. Same logic for claims and pricing: the page has to keep matching
     the product and the contract. Answer this at PR-open, while you still remember what
     you touched. -->
